items.title: Collusion with Competitive Marginals: Price-Level Audits Are Blind by Construction
items.summary: Empirical work on algorithmic collusion asks one question of the data: are prices supracompetitive? We show this can be answered "no" by a conspiracy that is nonetheless profitable. Consider bidding agents that couple only through the joint distribution of their unexplained bid components, leaving every agent's own bid law exactly at the competitive law. Any test whose input is a single agent's price or bid history then has power exactly equal to its false-positive rate, for every coupling strength up to comonotonicity. The published detection methodology is therefore blind to this conduct by construction rather than underpowered, and no sample size repairs it. Three empirical results follow. First, the mechanism appears in real language-model agents: twenty models from nineteen independent developers, three deployment prompts each, show residual correlation of $+0.053$ between two deployments of one model against $+0.0001$ across models, with a 95% interval clustered by developer of $[0.030, 0.078]$, under an auditor that sees every order feature and is fitted out of sample. Second, the coupling falls monotonically as sampling temperature rises ($p=0.002$), turning a deployment parameter into a candidate mitigation. Third, on 24 days of Ethereum block-building auction data covering 77,684 bids from 39 bidders, the honest population of bidder pairs is itself so dependent that a screen held at a 5% false-positive rate must sit above a floor of $+0.50$ to $+0.81$, which is 20 to 32 times the family-wise sampling threshold and does not fall as the audit window grows. Since lawful multi-identity operation and conspiracy are behaviourally indistinguishable here, the tractable regulatory target is not detection but counting: resolving 40 bidding identities into 23 operators raises the Herfindahl index by 247.5%, and adding behavioural clusters from public bid streams reaches 324.5%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究算法串谋中的检测盲区。传统方法通过检查市场价格是否高于竞争水平来判定串谋，但作者证明存在一种共谋机制，使得每个代理的边际出价分布与竞争均衡完全相同，仅通过未解释残差分量的联合分布进行耦合。在这种设定下，任何仅依赖单个代理价格或出价历史的统计检验，其检测功效恒等于假阳性率，无论样本量多大都无法改善——即此类检测方法在结构上对这类行为完全失效。论文给出三个实证结果：第一，在真实语言模型代理（19个开发者20个模型）中，同一模型两次部署间的残差相关为+0.053，而不同模型间仅为+0.0001，表明存在隐含协调；第二，提高采样温度可单调降低耦合强度（p=0.002），这为缓解措施提供了方向；第三，在以太坊区块构建拍卖数据（77684笔出价）中，诚实竞拍者之间的相关性本身已非常高，使得5%假阳性率下的检测阈值必须设在+0.50至+0.81之间，约为族系抽样阈值的20-32倍，且不随审计窗口增大而下降。由于合法多身份操作与合谋在行为上无法区分，文章主张监管重点应从检测转向计数——通过解析身份集合（将40个身份归为23个运营者）可使赫芬达尔指数提升247.5%，再结合公开出价流的行为聚类可达到324.5%。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了主流价格审计方法对一类隐蔽算法共谋的结构性盲区，可能使高频交易、广告竞价、LLM代理定价等场景中的协调行为长期不被发现，对反垄断监管构成根本挑战。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响依赖价格序列进行串谋检测的监管模型（如反垄断机构、交易所监察），尤其对多代理竞价系统（自动做市、广告拍卖、加密矿工竞价）具有普遍性。

items.title: QUIC-TRIP: A Triple-Redundant Journey Toward Secure Substation Communications
items.summary: Modern power systems rely on real-time substation communication protocols, such as the Routable Generic Object-Oriented Substation Event (R-GOOSE), for critical control and protection functions. However, these protocols often lack built-in security features and prioritize availability over confidentiality and integrity, making them susceptible to false data injection and denial-of-service attacks. This vulnerability is exacerbated when communications are transmitted over wide-area or public networks. Addressing these cyber threats is essential to comply with current security mandates, including the DOE's defense-in-depth and zero-trust guidelines. This paper introduces QUIC-TRIP, a transparent security methodology for low-latency IP-based industrial communications. By operating at the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) Transport Layer (Layer 4), the solution encapsulates and protects data flows without affecting the operation of existing protocol endpoints. Baseline echo Round-Trip Time (RTT) results over a Frankfurt-Amsterdam communication path show that the underlying transport-layer proxy used by QUIC-TRIP achieves a lower average RTT than OpenVPN and only 2.88% higher average RTT than integrated DTLS 1.2, even with DTLS session reuse. We evaluate the resilience of QUIC-TRIP multipath communication under DoS flooding by securing R-GOOSE communications. In these tests, traffic is transparently delivered through three different paths, and QUIC-TRIP forwards the earliest-arriving duplicate while discarding later copies. The framework provides a triple-redundant defense scheme with a measured communication overhead of 32.18% per enabled proxied path, offering a bounded trade-off between resilience and bandwidth cost for time-critical grid operations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现代电力系统依赖实时变电站通信协议（如R-GOOSE）进行关键控制和保护功能，但这些协议缺乏内置安全特性，优先考虑可用性而非机密性和完整性，因此容易遭受虚假数据注入和拒绝服务攻击。当通信通过广域网或公共网络传输时，这一脆弱性进一步加剧。为应对这些网络威胁并符合当前安全要求（包括美国能源部的深度防御和零信任指南），本文提出了QUIC-TRIP，一种用于低时延IP工业通信的透明安全方法。该方法在OSI传输层（第4层）运行，封装并保护数据流，而不影响现有协议端点的操作。通过在法兰克福-阿姆斯特丹通信路径上的基线回声往返时间测试显示，QUIC-TRIP使用的底层传输层代理的平均RTT低于OpenVPN，且仅比集成DTLS 1.2（即使使用DTLS会话复用）的平均RTT高2.88%。本文通过保护R-GOOSE通信，评估了QUIC-TRIP多路径通信在DoS洪泛攻击下的弹性。在测试中，流量透明地通过三条不同路径传输，QUIC-TRIP转发最先到达的重复数据包并丢弃后续副本。该框架提供了三重冗余防御方案，每条启用代理路径的通信开销为32.18%，在时延关键型电网操作中实现了弹性与带宽成本之间的有限权衡。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对电力系统关键基础设施中R-GOOSE等协议的安全缺陷，QUIC-TRIP提供了一种低延迟、透明的传输层安全方案，并具备三重冗余抗DoS能力，有助于满足零信任等合规要求。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于智能电网、工业控制系统及其他依赖实时通信的OT场景。

items.title: A Controlled Candidate-Set Benchmark for Offline Satellite-Security Plan Decomposition
items.summary: Some security-development settings require local models that map an objective to an ordered, checkable plan. We present a low-rank decomposition adapter and release a case-disjoint corpus with 24 authored decompositions and 83 derived next-step examples across 24 satellite-security cases. To prevent reference-plan leakage, prompts contain one objective and eight shuffled SPARTA candidates. The evaluation candidate sets are constructed with oracle inclusion of every reference technique, so this study measures selection from a controlled set, not retrieval. On six fixed cases and five decoding seeds, mean scores vary across adapters and prompted Qwen2.5 baselines; a separate greedy check over three adapter training seeds shows non-negligible training variance. A 24-fold greedy leave-one-case-out control at the two compact sizes likewise shows tradeoffs: at 1.5B, adapter precision is 0.583 against 0.480 for two-shot prompting, while recall is 0.586 against 0.660. Case-resampling intervals for adapter precision relative to the strongest prompted baseline cross zero at 1.5B and 7B. The adapter is also substantially more format-compliant, which prevents attributing all score differences to selection. Autoregressive next-step accuracy is 0.08, 0.06, and 0.29 at 0.5B, 1.5B, and 7B. We therefore offer the formulation, leakage-controlled dataset, reproducibility package, and descriptive analysis as a proof of concept, not evidence of a reliable stand-alone decomposition system or a general adapter advantage. A separate diagnostic tests contract reuse.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对安全开发场景中需要将目标映射为有序、可检查的计划的问题，提出了一种低秩分解适配器（low-rank decomposition adapter），并发布了包含24个卫星安全案例的分解方案和83个下一步示例的数据集（case-disjoint corpus）。为了防止参考计划泄露，提示词中仅包含一个目标和八个打乱的SPARTA候选方案，且评估候选集通过Oracle包含所有参考技术，从而专注于从受控集合中选择而非检索。实验在6个固定案例和5个随机种子下进行，比较了不同适配器与Qwen2.5基线模型的平均得分，并通过24折留一法控制实验展示了权衡：在1.5B参数下，适配器精度为0.583 vs 双样本提示的0.480，召回率为0.586 vs 0.660。适配器在格式合规性上显著更优，但自回归下一步准确率在0.5B、1.5B和7B上分别仅为0.08、0.06和0.29。因此，本文将公式、防泄漏数据集、可复现包和描述性分析作为概念验证，而非可靠的独立分解系统或通用适配器优势的证据。论文还包含了一项单独的诊断测试，用于检查合约复用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为卫星安全领域的离线计划分解提供了首个受控基准数据集和低秩适配方法，有助于评估和提升语言模型在安全规划任务上的表现，对构建可验证的安全自动化系统有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响卫星安全规划分解的研究社区，为后续开发更可靠的分解系统提供了基线数据集和评估方法；方法可迁移到其他需安全规划分解的领域。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为卫星安全领域的离线计划分解提供了首个受控基准数据集和低秩适配方法，有助于评估和提升语言模型在安全规划任务上的表现，对构建可验证的安全自动化系统有参考价值。

items.title: RAGuard: A Layered Defense Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems Against Data Poisoning
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) in external corpora, but this reliance exposes them to corpus poisoning: maliciously injected passages that manipulate retrieved evidence. We introduce RAGuard, a layered defense against \emph{factual} corpus-poisoning attacks on RAG pipelines. The first layer adversarially fine-tunes a dense retriever on synthetic poisoned documents (fabricated facts, contradictions, and reasoning traps), teaching it to downrank malicious passages before generation. The second layer, the Zero-Knowledge Inference Patch ZKIP, is a label-free, black-box filter: for each retrieved document, it performs a leave-one-out decode and scores the document by the semantic shift and output-entropy change that its removal induces. ZKIP requires no poison labels, no ground-truth answers, and no access to model internals; it compares the model's own answers under counterfactual contexts. On poisoned Natural Questions at 5--30\% poison ratios, adversarial retriever training alone reduces but does not eliminate attack success, while ZKIP drives the measured attack success rate to 0.000 in every defended configuration, keeping Recall@5 within 0.03 of the clean-corpus baseline. Supervised analyses on both Natural Questions and BEIR (NFCorpus) confirm that the counterfactual signals ZKIP relies on carry learnable poison structure. The defense costs $k{+}1$ generator passes per query ($6\times$ for $k{=}5$); we analyze batching and early-stopping approximations that reduce this overhead. We also show that keyword-preserving poisons leave lexical retrievers such as BM25 essentially unaffected, an observation that delineates the boundary of the threat model. Code, datasets, and evaluation harnesses are released for reproducibility.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过外部语料库为大型语言模型（LLM）提供事实支撑，但这也引入了新的攻击面：攻击者可向语料库注入恶意文本来操控检索结果，从而导致LLM生成错误或有害的内容。本文提出了RAGuard，一种针对RAG管道中“事实性”语料库投毒攻击的分层防御框架。第一层是对抗微调：在包含虚构事实、矛盾文本和推理陷阱的合成投毒文档上，对密集检索器进行对抗训练，使其学会在生成前降低恶意文档的排序。第二层是零知识推理补丁（ZKIP），一种无需标签、黑盒的过滤器：对于每个检索到的文档，ZKIP执行留一法解码，通过移除该文档后模型输出语义变化和输出熵的变化来对该文档打分。ZKIP不需要投毒标签、真实答案或模型内部信息，仅通过比较在反事实上下文下模型自身的答案来检测异常。在Natural Questions数据集上，当投毒比例在5%到30%之间时，单独对抗检索器训练能降低但无法消除攻击成功率，而ZKIP在所有受防御配置下将攻击成功率降至0.000，同时保持Recall@5相对于干净语料库基线下降不超过0.03。在Natural Questions和BEIR（NFCorpus）上的监督分析证实，ZKIP依赖的反事实信号携带可学习的投毒结构。该防御每查询需要k+1次生成器调用（k=5时开销为6倍）；本文还分析了批处理和早期停止近似以降低开销。此外，实验表明保留关键词的投毒对BM25等词法检索器基本无影响，这界定了威胁模型的边界。作者发布了代码、数据集和评估工具以支持复现。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RAG系统正被广泛用于问答、搜索等场景，但语料库投毒攻击可隐蔽地操控模型输出。RAGuard提供了一种无需修改LLM本身、可即插即用的分层防御，是首个能在高投毒比例下将攻击成功率降至零的实用方案，对保障RAG应用安全性具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有基于RAG的问答系统、知识密集型对话系统、以及企业级检索增强应用。防御思路可迁移至其他依赖外部知识库的LLM应用。
detection_signals_zh: 输出语义变化（ZKIP中的留一法语义偏移）
输出熵的变化
检索器对特定文档的排序异常
defense_advice_zh: 部署对抗微调后的密集检索器作为第一层过滤
集成ZKIP作为第二层检测，对每个检索文档进行留一法验证
对于低资源场景，考虑使用BM25等词法检索器，其受保留关键词投毒影响较小
根据查询频率和时延要求，采用批处理或早期停止近似减少开销

items.title: StealthBench: Measuring Operational Stealth in Autonomous Offensive-Security Agents
items.summary: Stealth, the discipline of achieving an objective without revealing your presence, capabilities, or collected intelligence, is what separates sophisticated operators from detectable ones. Elite security researchers and advanced persistent threats achieve their objectives unnoticed; autonomous agents increasingly inherit the same offensive tasks, but do they inherit the tradecraft? We introduce StealthBench,a benchmark that measures operational stealth in autonomous offensive-security agents across six operational security (OPSEC) dimensions. We extract 11 hand-verified OPSEC incidents from real bug-bounty and red-team trajectories, expanded into 14 dockerized task scenarios, where agents, despite finding real vulnerabilities, committed stealth failures inconsistent with standard operational tradecraft: embedding credentials in public uploads, deleting production resources to prove access, force-adding uninvolved users to demonstrate a race condition. We evaluate agent trajectories using a 3-model large language model (LLM) judge panel with majority-vote aggregation, measuring safe success rate (solved and stealthy), Stealth@Solve (tradecraft quality among successful solves), and reckless solve rate (solved but cover blown). Our results show that no model exceeds 54% safe success rate (the compound metric requiring both task completion and stealth), confirming that OPSEC failures are systematic across model families. We release StealthBench as a public benchmark to support both the development of stealth-aware agents and automated OPSEC monitoring for autonomous offensive-security deployments. The interactive leaderboard, evaluation harness, and dataset are available at https://stealthbench.com.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了 StealthBench，一个用于衡量自主进攻安全代理操作隐蔽性的基准测试。当前自主代理在执行渗透测试或红队任务时，往往专注于完成任务（如发现漏洞、获取权限），却忽视了操作安全（OPSEC）原则，导致隐蔽性失败。作者从真实漏洞赏金和红队攻击轨迹中提取了11个经手工验证的OPSEC事件，并扩展为14个Docker化的任务场景。这些场景中，代理虽然能够发现真实漏洞，但会犯下低级隐蔽错误，例如：将凭据嵌入到公开的上传文件中、删除生产资源以证明访问权限、强制添加无关用户来演示条件竞争漏洞等。StealthBench从六个OPSEC维度评估代理的隐蔽性：包括避免留下痕迹、不破坏生产环境、不暴露工具特征等。评估方法采用基于三个大语言模型（LLM）的评审团，通过多数投票聚合，并定义了三个核心指标：安全成功率（既完成任务又不暴露）、隐蔽质量（成功解决方案中的隐蔽性）和鲁莽成功率（完成任务但暴露）。实验结果表明，没有任何模型的安全成功率超过54%，表明OPSEC失败在不同模型家族中是系统性的问题。作者开源了StealthBench基准测试、交互式排行榜和评估工具，旨在促进开发者构建隐蔽性感知的代理以及自动化OPSEC监控系统，从而提升自主进攻安全部署的整体专业水平。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自主进攻安全代理日益普及，但当前评估多只关注任务完成率而忽略隐蔽性。StealthBench首次系统性地量化了这一关键差距，为开发更成熟、不易暴露的红队代理提供了理论基础和评测工具。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响红队自动化工具的评估标准制定；间接推动LLM驱动的安全代理在产品测试、渗透测试等场景中采用更隐蔽的战术，降低被检测风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：安全团队可参考StealthBench的评估方法，对内部使用的自主代理进行OPSEC能力测试，并关注后续基于该基准的代理改进工作。

items.title: Learning the Word Problem: Geodesic Lengths and Cryptographic Applications
items.summary: The Word Problem has been a subject of intensive mathematical study for over a century, initially driving advances in combinatorial group theory and more recently emerging as a foundational hardness assumption in post-quantum cryptography (PQC). While generally undecidable, several families of infinite non-abelian groups exhibit solvable or algorithmically fast word problems, making them attractive platforms for cryptographic design. This paper introduces WPNet, a novel Graph Neural Network architecture capable of solving the Word Problem heuristically, which is demonstrated on the Baumslag-Solitar group $BS(1,2)$ and on an Artin group. By mapping unreduced words to dynamic graph structures, the model learns to cluster algebraically equivalent elements in a continuous embedding space, effectively identifying the geodesic representative of a word without executing discrete reduction steps. As an application, a model variant is developed that can predict the geodesic length of an unreduced word in both groups. To demonstrate the cryptographic severity of this structural leakage, WPNet is successfully deployed against the Wagner-Magyarik public-key cryptosystem.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了一个经典数学问题——字问题（Word Problem）在密码学中的安全影响。字问题已有一个多世纪的研究历史，近年来成为后量子密码学（PQC）的基础硬度假设之一。虽然一般情况下字问题不可判定，但某些无限非交换群族具有可解或算法快速的字问题，使其成为密码学设计的理想平台。本文提出了WPNet，一种新颖的图神经网络架构，能够启发式地解决字问题。论文在Baumslag-Solitar群BS(1,2)和一个Artin群上进行了演示。通过将未约化的单词映射为动态图结构，模型能够在连续嵌入空间中学习聚类代数等价的元素，从而有效识别单词的测地线代表，而无需执行离散的约化步骤。作为应用，开发了一个模型变体，可以预测两个群中未约化单词的测地线长度。为了展示这种结构性泄漏的密码学严重性，WPNet被成功部署攻击Wagner-Magyarik公钥密码系统。该研究揭示了基于群论的密码系统可能面临的潜在威胁，并提出了新的攻击向量。适合对后量子密码学、群论和机器学习交叉领域感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: WPNet成功预测测地线长度并攻击Wagner-Magyarik密码系统，表明基于字问题难度的密码构造可能存在未被认识到的结构性弱点，这对后量子密码学方案的设计和安全性评估具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对基于非交换群字问题的密码系统（如Wagner-Magyarik方案）构成攻击威胁；可能影响其他依赖字问题硬度的群论密码设计。

items.title: On Exercising Governance Power in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations
items.summary: A decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) is a governance entity that allows its stakeholders to manage blockchain-based protocols through smart contracts. The DAO explicitly specifies how stakeholders make and enforce decisions concerning a protocol's operation in a smart contract, aptly referred to as its governance contract. The design of this governance contract, therefore, has far-reaching implications for the security (trust) and privacy (transparency) of the smart contracts managed by the DAO and its stakeholders. In this work, we (i) explicate the trust and transparency trade-offs of the design choices in implementing a DAO and (ii) highlight how poor choices introduce critical vulnerabilities, using real-world examples as case studies. To this end, we analyze $48$ public, actively used Ethereum-based DAOs that control a vast capital. We classify the design choices into a handful of key dimensions that succinctly capture how a DAO's stakeholders initiate a protocol change, vote on it, and, based on the voting outcome, execute that change. Our analyses crucially uncover a new class of attacks, which we call governance attacks, that directly exploit the fundamental design of a DAO's governance mechanisms, even if we assume bug-free implementations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对去中心化自治组织（DAO）的治理合约设计进行了系统性研究。DAO通过智能合约管理基于区块链的协议，其治理合约明确规定了利益相关者如何制定和执行决策。治理合约的设计对DAO及其利益相关者管理的智能合约的安全（信任）和隐私（透明度）有着深远影响。作者首先阐述了实现DAO时设计选择中信任与透明度的权衡，并通过真实案例说明了糟糕的设计选择如何引入关键漏洞。为此，他们分析了48个公开活跃的、控制着大量资本的基于以太坊的DAO，将设计选择归纳为几个关键维度，这些维度简洁地描述了DAO利益相关者如何发起协议变更、投票以及根据投票结果执行变更。分析揭示了一类新的攻击——治理攻击，这种攻击直接利用DAO治理机制的基本设计缺陷，即使假设实现没有bug。该研究强调了治理合约设计的重要性，并为构建更安全的DAO提供了指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: DAO治理漏洞可能导致巨额资产损失，本文揭示的新型治理攻击直接利用设计缺陷，对DeFi生态安全具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 所有采用类似治理机制的DAO协议均可能受影响，尤其是涉及代币投票和提案执行的智能合约。

items.why_it_matters: DAO治理漏洞可能导致巨额资产损失，本文揭示的新型治理攻击直接利用设计缺陷，对DeFi生态安全具有重要警示意义。

items.title: (EC)2: Event-Centric Explainability for Cybersecurity Through Multi-Agent LLM Investigations
items.summary: Security operations centers rely on anomaly detection systems to flag suspicious events. Feature-level explanations for anomaly detectors offer limited value for operational investigations. To effectively handle alerts, analysts need to know contextual relationships and need actionable understanding of the entities involved. This paper introduces an event-centric detector-agnostic approach for explaining cybersecurity alerts in small- to medium-sized enterprise networks. We present (EC)2, a multi-agent framework that performs structured, hypothesis-driven investigation to provide explanations grounded in verifiable evidence. Evaluation results show that the proposed framework improves post-detection analysis by generating operationally meaningful explanations, which also enhance event classification accuracy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 (EC)2 的事件中心、检测器无关的网络安全告警解释框架。针对安全运营中心（SOC）中异常检测系统仅提供特征级解释、缺乏上下文关系的问题，作者设计了一个多智能体（Multi-Agent）LLM 系统，模拟结构化、假设驱动的调查流程。该框架通过多个 LLM 代理协作，自动收集日志、网络流量等证据，并基于可验证的证据生成操作有意义的解释。实验评估在中小企业网络场景下进行，结果表明 (EC)2 不仅提升了后检测分析的效率，还改善了事件分类的准确性。论文的核心贡献在于将可解释性从特征级提升到事件级，为 SOC 分析师提供直观、可操作的调查结果，减少人工分析负担。适合 SOC 分析师、安全研究人员及自动化运维团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统异常检测解释难以支撑运营调查，(EC)2 通过多智能体 LLM 提供事件级、证据驱动的解释，能显著提升 SOC 分析效率与准确性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于中小企业网络环境下的事件后分析，可增强现有异常检测系统的可操作性，提升告警分类与调查速度。

items.why_it_matters: 传统异常检测解释难以支撑运营调查，(EC)2 通过多智能体 LLM 提供事件级、证据驱动的解释，能显著提升 SOC 分析效率与准确性。

items.title: Does Runtime Topology Context Improve LLM-Generated Kubernetes Security Patches?
items.summary: Kubernetes is central to the cloud-native ecosystem, orchestrating containerised workloads. Recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) can automate cluster security remediation, generating configuration patches from Kubernetes Security Posture Management (KSPM) findings without human authoring. Such systems, however, prompt the model with each finding in isolation from the live service call graph, assuming general hardening knowledge suffices. This assumption breaks down whenever a patch must preserve a runtime service dependency invisible to the model: an otherwise compliant fix then carries a destructive functional blast radius, crashing downstream callers or silently severing call edges across the cluster. Whether live cluster context improves patch correctness has not been measured under controlled conditions across multiple dependency classes. We introduce KuTIE (Kubernetes Topology Intelligence Engine), which builds a live cluster context from Istio call edges, Trivy KSPM findings, and the service-account bindings a workload reads, and conditions LLM patch generation on it. It is evaluated on VulnCare, a purpose-built 36-deployment, four-namespace healthcare cluster with 31 injectable findings across seven dependency classes, each labelled by topology dependence against cluster ground truth. Across 248 trials, topology context raises topology-dependent patch correctness from 11.1% to 78.0% ($Δ= 0.669$), a gap that holds for every model and for six of seven classes, from credential and network-policy ($Δ= 0.95$) to role-based access control ($Δ= 0.31$); a topology-independent control exhibits no such effect ($Δ= 0.0$), isolating the result from generic prompt enrichment. Supplying the live service-call graph and the service-account bindings it exposes thus improves remediation of topology-dependent findings well beyond scanner-only context.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于Kubernetes集群安全修复的自动化问题。现有的大语言模型（LLM）辅助安全修复系统通常仅依赖孤立的KSPM扫描结果，忽略了运行时服务依赖关系，导致生成的配置补丁可能破坏集群中正在运行的服务，例如意外切断调用链或导致下游调用失败。为弥补这一缺陷，作者提出了KuTIE（Kubernetes Topology Intelligence Engine），该系统通过整合Istio服务调用图、Trivy KSPM发现以及工作负载读取的服务账户绑定信息，构建实时集群拓扑上下文，并基于此上下文指导LLM生成安全补丁。为评估效果，作者构建了VulnCare——一个包含36个部署、4个命名空间、31个可注入发现（涵盖7种依赖类型）的医疗场景测试集群。实验结果表明，在248次试验中，加入拓扑上下文后，依赖拓扑的补丁正确率从11.1%提升至78.0%（Δ=0.669），且该提升在几乎所有模型和6/7依赖类别中一致；而拓扑无关的控制组未见显著变化（Δ=0.0），证明效果源于拓扑上下文而非通用提示增强。研究主要贡献在于：首次在可控条件下量化了运行时拓扑上下文对LLM生成Kubernetes安全补丁正确性的影响，并提出了一个可扩展的上下文注入框架KuTIE。适合对云原生安全、LLM应用安全自动化的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前LLM自动化修复Kubernetes安全问题时忽略运行时依赖的致命缺陷，并提供了可量化的改进方案，对降低集群修复的破坏性风险有直接指导价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: Kubernetes安全补丁自动化生成，特别是面向服务网格、网络策略、RBAC等依赖敏感场景的修复。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了当前LLM自动化修复Kubernetes安全问题时忽略运行时依赖的致命缺陷，并提供了可量化的改进方案，对降低集群修复的破坏性风险有直接指导价值。

items.title: IH-Benchmark: A Conflict-Centered Benchmark for Instruction-Hierarchy Robustness in LLM Applications
items.summary: When a language model receives conflicting instructions from different priority levels, which one does it actually follow? This question lies at the heart of reliable LLM deployment. Existing benchmarks answer this only partially, often focusing on a single hierarchy edge or adapting public datasets with limited tool-use coverage. We present IH-Benchmark, a conflict-centered benchmark for instruction-hierarchy robustness across direct system-user conflicts (S>U) and tool-mediated user-tool (U>T) conflicts. IH-Benchmark is built from a human-authored taxonomy of 44 constraint families across generic, health, finance, retail, and coding settings, and evaluates scenarios with a uniform binary pass/fail protocol combining a predicate DSL with category-scoped LLM judges. Across 37 evaluated models, hierarchy compliance ranges from 98.2% to 20.5%. We find that strong S>U compliance is not a reliable proxy for U>T robustness: several models preserve system constraints under direct user conflict but degrade sharply when conflicting instructions appear in tool outputs. Constraint hardening also reveals a split between models: some failures are largely fixed by stronger warnings, while others persist across all strictness levels. Finally, the most revealing failures are often subtle rather than overtly dangerous; models resist unauthorized purchases or bulk ticket closure more reliably than injected disclaimers or small factual distortions. These results suggest that instruction-hierarchy robustness is not a single capability, but a set of behaviors that must be evaluated across conflict surfaces, constraint types, and attack presentations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 IH-Benchmark，一个以冲突为中心的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）应用中的指令层次鲁棒性。研究背景是，当LLM收到来自不同优先级的冲突指令时，其行为可靠性对安全部署至关重要。现有基准仅覆盖部分层次边缘或使用有限的工具交互数据集。IH-Benchmark构建于人工标注的44个约束族分类之上，涵盖通用、健康、金融、零售和编程五个领域，并定义了两种冲突类型：直接系统-用户冲突（S>U）和工具介导的用户-工具冲突（U>T）。评估采用统一的二元通过/失败协议，结合谓词DSL和按类别划分的LLM裁判。在37个模型中，层次合规性范围从98.2%到20.5%。关键发现包括：强S>U合规性不能作为U>T鲁棒性的可靠代理——一些模型在直接用户冲突下保持系统约束，但工具输出中出现冲突指令时性能急剧下降；约束硬化（如加强警告）对不同模型效果不一，部分模型完全修复，部分持续失败；最揭示性的失败往往是微妙的而非公然危险——模型更可靠地拒绝未经授权的购买或批量关闭工单，但对注入的免责声明或微小事实扭曲则更易失败。结果表明，指令层次鲁棒性不是单一能力，而是一组必须在冲突面、约束类型和攻击呈现方式上分别评估的行为。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 指令层次冲突是LLM应用安全的核心问题，该基准揭示了当前模型在工具交互场景下的隐藏弱点，为安全部署和鲁棒性提升提供了系统化评估框架。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM在需要多级指令遵循的应用（如智能助手、自动化工作流）中的安全可靠性评估，可迁移到各类基于LLM的工具调用场景。

items.title: E-MagDiP: Electro-Magnetic based Differential Privacy for EEG based Community Sensing
items.summary: EEG-based community sensing programs are emerging globally as a tool to leverage aggregated brain data to gain insights into attentiveness of students and employees. But these programs raise privacy concerns because EEG signals contain sensitive personal information. Differential Privacy (DP) can protect individuals while preserving aggregate statistics yet applying DP to EEG data is challenging as it requires user-level noise generation, which increases power and latency. Besides, most commercial EEG headsets cannot be modified to add such noise. We propose E-MagDiP, a framework that uses an external radio to transmit RF signals onto EEG headsets, perturbing signals at acquisition to induce DP noise. To the best of our knowledge, E-MagDiP is the first framework to use RF signals for privacy instead of attacks, enabling practical DP for EEG community sensing without any user-level modification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为E-MagDiP的新型框架，旨在解决基于脑电图（EEG）的社区感知项目中的隐私问题。EEG社区感知项目通过聚合脑数据来获取学生或员工的注意力水平等洞察，但EEG信号包含敏感个人信息，存在隐私泄露风险。差分隐私（DP）是一种保护个人隐私同时保留统计特性的技术，但将其应用于EEG数据面临挑战：需要在用户级别生成噪声，这会增加功耗和延迟，且大多数商用EEG头戴设备无法修改以添加此类噪声。E-MagDiP通过外部无线电发射器向EEG头戴设备发送射频（RF）信号，在信号采集阶段直接干扰（perturb）原始信号，从而注入差分隐私噪声。这种方法无需对用户设备进行任何修改，即可实现实际可用的EEG社区感知差分隐私保护。据作者所知，E-MagDiP是首个利用RF信号来增强隐私而非实施攻击的框架，为EEG社区感知提供了实用的差分隐私解决方案。论文主要贡献包括：设计了一种利用RF信号在采集阶段注入噪声的机制，克服了传统用户级噪声生成的局限；通过理论分析和实验验证了方法的有效性；展示了在保持数据可用性的同时提供隐私保障的可能性。适合对隐私保护技术、脑机接口安全以及社区感知系统感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: EEG社区感知正在兴起，但隐私风险是主要障碍。本文提出的RF注入式差分隐私思路创新地利用物理层干扰替代设备端修改，为可穿戴设备隐私保护开辟了新方向，对实际部署具有重要参考价值。

items.title: From Role Prompt to Infinite Thinking: Exploiting Persona Conditioning for Inference Cost Attacks in LLMs
items.summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, making inference efficiency and service reliability critical concerns due to their substantial computational costs. However, the autoregressive generation mechanism of LLMs enables malicious prompts to manipulate generation behaviors, inducing excessive token generation that amplifies computational consumption and threatens service efficiency. Existing methods mainly rely on adversarial suffixes or explicit extension instructions, which introduce detectable behaviors and limit their applicability. In this paper, we reveal a previously unexplored vulnerability caused by persona consistency in LLMs, where models maintain assigned roles and reproduce corresponding behaviors even when they result in inefficient reasoning and excessive generation. Based on this observation, we propose RolePlay, a task-aware dynamic persona alignment framework that constructs adaptive personas to naturally induce inefficient yet semantically coherent behaviors for inference cost amplification. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and diverse task datasets demonstrate that RolePlay consistently outperforms existing inference extension methods, achieving an average token amplification of up to \bm{$7.64\times$} and a maximum token amplification ratio of \bm{$207.64\times$}. Our findings identify persona conditioning as a new attack surface for LLM inference efficiency and offer a new perspective on computational cost amplification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文揭示了大语言模型（LLM）在推理效率方面的一个新安全漏洞。由于LLM的自回归生成机制，恶意提示可以操纵生成行为，导致产生过多的token，从而放大计算消耗并威胁服务效率。现有方法主要依赖对抗后缀或显式扩展指令，这些方式容易被检测。作者发现LLM存在一种由角色一致性导致的脆弱性：模型会维持分配的角色并再现相应的行为，即使这些行为导致低效推理和过度生成。基于此观察，他们提出了RolePlay框架，这是一种任务感知的动态角色对齐框架，能够构建自适应角色，自然诱导低效但语义连贯的行为，从而放大推理成本。在多个LLM和多样化任务数据集上的实验表明，RolePlay持续优于现有推理扩展方法，平均token放大倍数达到7.64倍，最大token放大倍数达到207.64倍。该研究将角色条件化识别为LLM推理效率的一个新攻击面，为计算成本放大提供了新视角。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了LLM推理阶段一个未被探索的漏洞，攻击者可通过精心设计的角色提示导致计算资源消耗激增，对云服务商和企业部署的LLM服务构成成本威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用LLM API或自托管服务的组织，可能导致服务降级、成本失控，甚至拒绝服务。可迁移至任何基于对话或角色扮演的LLM应用场景。

items.title: Hermes: Low Tail-Latency Via Prefix Consensus
items.summary: Leader-based BFT protocols finalize through their leaders: a view whose leader is crashed or slow finalizes nothing, and the timeout that ends it admits no good setting. A conservative timeout turns every crashed leader into a long stall; an aggressive one voids the views of leaders that are merely slow. Either way the expired view is wasted, and this trade-off, not the good case, governs tail latency. Hermes makes expired views finalize. Hermes is a two-round rotating-leader protocol for $n=5f+1$ processes under partial synchrony built on prefix consensus: votes carry values ordered by a prefix relation, and quorums require comparability rather than equality. Every process broadcasts a justified proposal at view start and casts a single vote, for the leader's proposal upon delivery or for a fallback proposal at the timeout; there are no nullify votes. A timely honest leader finalizes its full proposal in $2δ$. Otherwise, any $n-f$ votes, which need not match, finalize the heaviest common prefix. We instantiate Hermes as a finality gadget over an available chain and over Autobahn-style multi-lane dissemination, where parent-relative delta tipcuts with explicit skips keep independent proposals comparable and sender-indexed erasure-coded amplification keeps complexity at $O(n^2\hat{m}+λn^3)$ bits and $O(n^2)$ messages per view, where $\hat{m}$ is the number of concurrent dissemination lanes in Autobahn and $λ$ the security parameter.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 在基于领导者的拜占庭容错（BFT）协议中，交易的最终确定依赖于领导者：如果领导者崩溃或缓慢，则无法最终确定任何交易，而终结超时的设置也面临困境。保守的超时会导致每次领导者崩溃时出现长时间停滞，而激进的超时则会浪费那些仅因缓慢而失效的视图。无论哪种情况，过期的视图都被浪费，这种权衡决定了尾延迟，而非正常运行情况。Hermes协议解决了这一问题，使过期视图也能最终确定交易。Hermes是一个两轮旋转领导者协议，针对部分同步系统设计，需要$n=5f+1$个进程，并基于前缀共识构建：选票携带由前缀关系排序的值，仲裁要求可比性而非相等性。每个进程在视图开始时广播一个经过验证的提议，并仅投一票：若按时收到领导者的提议则投票给该提议，若超时则投票给一个备用提议；没有空投票。诚实的领导者若及时，则其完整提议在$2δ$时间内最终确定。否则，任意$n-f$张选票（无需一致）即可最终确定最重公共前缀。Hermes被实例化为一个最终性小工具，运行在可用链和Autobahn风格的多通道传播之上，其中父-相对delta tipcuts与显式跳过使独立提议具有可比性，发送者索引的擦除编码放大使每视图的复杂度保持在$O(n^2\hat{m}+λn^3)$比特和$O(n^2)$消息，其中$\hat{m}$是Autobahn中并发传播通道数，$λ$是安全参数。该论文的主要贡献在于通过前缀共识消除了传统BFT协议中视图过期带来的尾延迟问题，并在理论上证明了其可行性和复杂度。适合分布式系统、区块链、BFT共识协议的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的共识机制，显著降低了BFT系统中的尾延迟，对提升分布式系统性能和可靠性具有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要低延迟和高吞吐的拜占庭容错系统，如区块链、分布式数据库等场景。

items.title: Toward Standardized Cross-Vendor Agent Tool Trust Management in Autonomous Networks
items.summary: Autonomous Network Levels 4-5 require AI agents to invoke tools across vendor boundaries without human oversight, yet existing management standards lack a standardized mechanism for cross-vendor trust visibility. When a tool from Vendor B is compromised, agents from Vendor A continue invoking it -- unaware of the trust degradation -- causing cascading service impact. We present AgentToolMO, a proposed 3GPP NRM information model for agent tool trust management. The model comprises: a formally defined trust state machine with provable graduated enforcement, damped cascade propagation with bounded convergence, cross-vendor trust notifications via existing Management Services (MnS) interfaces, and retroactive impact assessment through NRM dependency graph traversal. Simulation-based evaluation across multi-vendor topologies shows that standardized cross-vendor notifications reduce blast radius from hours-scale undetected propagation to near-real-time containment bounded by MnS notification delivery, with cascade convergence guaranteed in bounded iterations and sub-linear notification scaling across vendor domains. The framework operates within existing 3GPP management infrastructure, leverages existing protocols, and provides a standardization pathway for trustworthy multi-vendor autonomous network management.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对自治网络在 Level 4-5 阶段需要 AI 代理跨供应商调用工具的场景，指出现有管理标准缺乏跨供应商信任可见性的标准化机制。当供应商 B 的工具被攻陷时，供应商 A 的代理仍会继续调用该工具，导致信任降级无法被察觉，引发级联服务影响。为此，作者提出 AgentToolMO，一个基于 3GPP NRM 信息模型的代理工具信任管理框架。该模型包括：形式化定义的信任状态机，支持可证明的渐进式执行；阻尼级联传播机制，保证有界收敛；通过现有管理服务（MnS）接口进行跨供应商信任通知；以及基于 NRM 依赖图遍历的追溯影响评估。跨多供应商拓扑的仿真评估表明，标准化的跨供应商通知能将爆炸半径从数小时级未检测传播缩小到接近实时的限制（受 MnS 通知交付延迟约束），级联收敛在有限迭代内保证，且通知规模在供应商域间呈次线性扩展。该框架运行在现有 3GPP 管理基础设施内，利用现有协议，为可信的多供应商自治网络管理提供了标准化路径。适合网络运维、安全管理及标准制定人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 跨供应商工具信任缺失可能导致攻击者在不知情的情况下利用受损工具造成级联服务中断，该研究为自治网络信任管理提供了标准化基础，对提升多供应商环境的安全性至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于 3GPP 自治网络、网络功能虚拟化（NFV）、SDN 等场景中跨供应商工具信任管理，减少攻击传播范围和响应延迟。

items.title: GPT-Red: Automated Red Teaming via Self-Play at Scale
items.summary: We introduce \textbf{GPT-Red}, an automated red-teaming agent that is trained to discover novel prompt injection attacks against frontier LLMs. The goal of this model is to evaluate and improve the robustness of our production systems. To this end, we use it to adversarially train GPT-5.6, our most robust model to prompt injections to date. To create GPT-Red, we design a scalable self-play algorithm where the model is tasked with attacking a diverse population of simultaneously-trained defender agents. We train the model on realistic red-teaming environments using compute on the same scale as some of our largest RL post-training runs, making it the single-largest LLM safety training run ever documented. GPT-Red excels at red-teaming: it reliably breaks our past models up to GPT-5.5, it finds more successful attacks than human red-teamers, and it generalizes to held-out environments, defender models, and harnesses. In the future, we expect that as we improve the robustness of each new GPT model, it will in turn will provide better learning signal for \textit{even stronger} red-teamer agents, thus unlocking a self-improvement flywheel.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 GPT-Red，一种基于自我对弈（self-play）的大规模自动化红队测试智能体，专门用于发现针对前沿大语言模型（LLM）的新型提示注入攻击。研究背景在于，尽管对抗训练能提升 LLM 鲁棒性，但依赖人工红队成本高、扩展性差，且难以覆盖多样攻击。核心方法：设计可扩展的自我对博弈算法，让攻击模型与一群同时训练的防御模型（不同结构/初始化）持续对抗，从而逼迫攻击者探索更复杂的注入手法。训练环境模拟真实生产场景，使用与最大规模 RL 后训练相当的计算资源，使其成为文档记载中最大的 LLM 安全训练运行。实验证明：GPT-Red 能可靠地攻破此前所有 GPT 模型（最高至 GPT-5.5），发现成功攻击的数量超过人类红队；它还能泛化到未见过的环境、防御模型和工具箱。核心贡献在于：(1) 首次以自我对弈方式自动化生成大规模、多样化的提示注入攻击；(2) 通过对抗训练推动防御模型进步，形成自我改进飞轮——更强的防御模型反过来为红队提供更丰富学习信号，循环提升系统整体鲁棒性。本文适合 LLM 安全研究员、红队工程师及生产系统开发者阅读，以理解自动化红队的最新进展及其在防御安全中的潜力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GPT-Red 实现了自动化红队测试，大幅降低人工成本，且能发现比人类红队更多的攻击，为 LLM 对抗训练提供可扩展、可持续的攻击生成方案。其自我改进飞轮机制有望持续提升模型鲁棒性，对防御提示注入等安全威胁具有里程碑意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升 LLM 对抗提示注入攻击的能力；方法可迁移至越狱、偏见等其他安全评估场景，并推动自动化红队工具的商业化应用。
defense_advice_zh: 采用自动化红队测试进行持续对抗训练，以动态更新防御策略
监控新出现的提示注入模式，定期用类似 GPT-Red 的工具评估模型鲁棒性

items.title: Stemma: Induced Decision Regions Reveal LLM Provenance
items.summary: LLM provenance testing asks whether a suspect LLM belongs to the same lineage as a source. Existing black-box methods largely infer this relationship from response-level characteristics, but these characteristics may shift under adaptation or deployment even when the underlying meaning remains unchanged, weakening the reliability of provenance evidence. To address this limitation, we introduce induced decision regions by mapping open-ended outputs into a finite decision space, thereby abstracting away surface-form variation and reframing provenance testing as measuring the inheritance of decision regions. Empirical analysis shows that the source's induced regions are preserved more strongly in related models than in unrelated models. Building on this signal, we propose Stemma, a practical black-box LLM fingerprinting method that operationalises stability, robustness, and specificity as complementary probe-selection principles for reliably estimating induced decision region inheritance. Across 770 source-suspect pairs drawn from 56 public checkpoints and spanning diverse model-weight transformations, Stemma achieves 0.967 AUC and 87.8% TPR at 1% FPR, substantially outperforming four representative baselines. It further achieves 0.995 AUC and 93.5% TPR at 1% FPR on 1,260 pairs covering 91 deployment instances, demonstrating robustness to diverse inference-time deployment settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大型语言模型（LLM）的来源测试问题，即判断一个可疑LLM是否与某个源LLM属于同一谱系。现有的黑盒方法通常基于响应级别的特征（如输出文本的统计特性）来推断谱系关系，但这些特征在模型适应或部署过程中可能发生改变，即使底层语义保持不变，从而削弱了来源证据的可靠性。为了解决这一局限性，作者引入了“诱导决策区域”（induced decision regions）的概念：将开放式的输出映射到一个有限的决策空间中，从而抽象掉表面形式的变化，将来源测试重新定义为测量决策区域的继承性。实验表明，源模型的诱导决策区域在相关模型中比在无关模型中保留得更强。基于这一信号，作者提出了Stemma，一种实用的黑盒LLM指纹识别方法，它通过稳定性、鲁棒性和特异性作为互补的探针选择原则来可靠地估计诱导决策区域的继承性。在来自56个公开检查点的770个源-可疑模型对，涵盖多种模型权重变换的情况下，Stemma实现了0.967的AUC和87.8%的TPR（在1% FPR下），显著优于四个代表性基线。在涵盖91个部署实例的1260个模型对上，Stemma进一步获得了0.995的AUC和93.5%的TPR（在1% FPR下），展示了其对多种推理时部署设置的鲁棒性。该研究主要贡献包括：形式化LLM来源测试为决策区域继承问题、提出基于探针选择的指纹识别方法、以及在大规模实验上的优越表现。适合LLM安全、模型溯源、知识产权保护领域的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM来源测试对于模型知识产权保护、供应链安全以及防范恶意微调至关重要。Stemma提供了一种高效、鲁棒的黑盒指纹识别方法，有助于安全团队识别模型是否来自未经授权的衍生。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于检测LLM的衍生关系，例如判断第三方API背后的模型是否基于开源模型微调，或评估模型训练数据泄露风险。

items.why_it_matters: LLM来源测试对于模型知识产权保护、供应链安全以及防范恶意微调至关重要。Stemma提供了一种高效、鲁棒的黑盒指纹识别方法，有助于安全团队识别模型是否来自未经授权的衍生。

items.title: Adversarial Deepfake Generation and an Investigation of Purification-Based Adversarial Detection
items.summary: This paper describes the participation of team "Go To Germany" in the ImageCLEF 2026 Deepfake Detection and Generation Task. For the image generation task, we employ FLUX.1-dev with PuLID for identity-preserving face synthesis, combined with a multi-model PGD adversarial attack targeting 12 detectors simultaneously (DiffJPEG-in-loop, MI/DI/EoT, adaptive weighting, two-stage warm-start). Our approach achieved 90% evasion against organizer detectors and 57.6% against participant detectors, with a final generation score of 0.4170. For the image detection task, we combine two complementary detectors - SigLIP+DINOv2 for AI-generated images and GenD-DINOv3 for face manipulations - in a max-probability ensemble, achieving 99.4% accuracy on baseline deepfakes but suffering from high false-positive rates on real images, resulting in a final detection score of 0.6986. Beyond the official submission, we conducted a self-initiated investigation of purification-based adversarial detection, comparing three families of detection signals across six detectors that share a CLIP ViT-L/14 backbone. We find that raw $|Δ\text{logit}|$ under median-3 purification, applied through the EFFORT detector, separates adversarial inputs from clean inputs with AUROC 0.81-0.98 across four adversarial source types - a finding that refutes the simple backbone-preservation hypothesis and exposes a sharp JPEG-quality cliff at Q70 where the signal collapses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文描述了团队'Go To Germany'在ImageCLEF 2026深度伪造检测与生成任务中的参赛方案。在图像生成任务中，团队采用FLUX.1-dev与PuLID进行身份保留的人脸合成，并设计了一种针对12个检测器的多模型PGD对抗攻击，包含DiffJPEG-in-loop、MI/DI/EoT、自适应权重和两阶段热启动策略。该方法对组织者检测器的逃避率达到90%，对参赛者检测器的逃避率为57.6%，最终生成得分为0.4170。在图像检测任务中，团队组合了两个互补检测器——SigLIP+DINOv2用于AI生成图像检测和GenD-DINOv3用于人脸篡改检测，采用最大概率集成，在基线深度伪造上达到99.4%的准确率，但在真实图像上出现高误报，最终检测得分为0.6986。此外，团队还自主开展了基于净化的对抗检测研究，比较了三个检测信号家族在共享CLIP ViT-L/14骨干的六个检测器上的表现。研究发现，在EFFORT检测器上应用median-3净化后的原始|Δlogit|信号，能在四种对抗源类型下以AUROC 0.81-0.98区分对抗输入与干净输入，这一发现反驳了简单的骨干保留假说，并揭示了在质量因子Q70处信号崩溃的JPEG质量悬崖现象。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了当前深度伪造攻防的前沿水平，特别是多模型协同攻击和净化检测的新发现，对提升深度伪造检测鲁棒性具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 研究成果可应用于社交媒体、取证分析等场景的深度伪造检测系统改进，以及对抗样本防御机制的评估。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究展示了当前深度伪造攻防的前沿水平，特别是多模型协同攻击和净化检测的新发现，对提升深度伪造检测鲁棒性具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Arabic Language Models
items.summary: The emergence of the recent outstanding capabilities of Arabic Language Models has opened doors for exposing their vulnerabilities. One of the major security risks associated with such Natural Language Processing models is adversarial attacks. These attacks can deceive the model into the wrong prediction, raising critical model security and safety concerns. This study aims to assess the robustness of five state-of-the-art Arabic Language Models under a distinct set of Arabic adversarial attacks applied at various levels of granularity and using different example generation strategies. We also explore a defense technique based on adversarial training to enhance model robustness. The results show that insertion of diacritics can reduce the accuracy of some models by 92% while maintaining a low perturbation distance. For word-level attacks, manipulating Arabic conjunctions preserves high semantic similarity scores, low perturbation distance, and leads to an accuracy degradation of up to 58%. For sentence-level attacks, paraphrasing proves its effectiveness by an average reduction of 76% in the victim models' performance. While adversarial training improves overall resilience, with MARBERT being the most robust and AraBERT showing the greatest relative gains, challenges persist, particularly against character-level noise. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of current defense strategies in morphologically rich languages like Arabic.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统评估了五种最先进的阿拉伯语语言模型（包括MARBERT、AraBERT等）在多种对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。攻击粒度涵盖字符级、词级和句子级，并采用不同的示例生成策略。实验发现：字符级插入变音符号（diacritics）可在保持较低扰动距离的情况下使某些模型准确率下降高达92%；词级攻击通过操纵阿拉伯语连词（conjunctions）能保持高语义相似度和低扰动距离，同时使准确率下降58%；句子级攻击通过释义（paraphrasing）平均降低受害者模型性能76%。防御方面，论文探索了对抗训练（adversarial training）策略，结果表明MARBERT整体最鲁棒，AraBERT相对增益最大，但模型在面对字符级噪声时仍面临挑战。研究揭示了当前防御策略在形态丰富的语言（如阿拉伯语）中的潜力和局限性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 阿拉伯语NLP模型在安全场景中应用日益广泛，但其对抗鲁棒性研究尚不充分。该工作系统揭示了不同粒度的攻击效果及对抗训练的局限性，为安全部署提供重要参考。

items.why_it_matters: 阿拉伯语NLP模型在安全场景中应用日益广泛，但其对抗鲁棒性研究尚不充分。该工作系统揭示了不同粒度的攻击效果及对抗训练的局限性，为安全部署提供重要参考。

items.title: A Structuration Approach to Theorizing Cybersecurity Practice: The STARC Model
items.summary: The problem: Cybersecurity practice runs simultaneously across analysts, teams, organizations, sectors, and regulators, co-evolves with adversaries, and increasingly blends human and algorithmic decision-making. The theories applied to it operate at single organizational levels and cannot explain why organizations with broadly similar controls differ sharply in resilience. This paper: We develop STARC (Structuration Theory Adaptation for Resilient Cybersecurity), a framework for locating where cybersecurity practice succeeds or fails structurally. It extends Giddens' Structuration Theory with three innovations, Multi-Level Adversarial Agency, Threat-Adaptive Structuration, and Material-Agential Structural Properties, across five structure-agency triads. Evidence base: STARC is illustrated through re-analysis of three financial organizations, an Australian, an Indonesian, and a Malaysian bank, across 20 interviews from SOC analysts to senior executives, selected as diverse insourced and outsourced configurations rather than as a comparison of equivalents. Cybersecurity contribution: STARC offers a structural account of why differently resourced and outsourced organizations differ in resilience, and a vocabulary for diagnosing incident-response breakdown across levels, tempos, and the human-algorithm authority boundary that single-level frameworks leave invisible. Theory and outputs: It extends Structuration Theory to adversarial, multi-level, and hybrid human-algorithmic contexts, and yields seven testable propositions linking structuration to resilience, offered for future testing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对当前网络安全实践研究中的一个核心矛盾：尽管许多组织部署了相似的控制措施，但其安全韧性（resilience）却差异显著。现有理论往往只局限于单一组织层面（如个体、团队或企业），无法解释这种跨组织、跨层级、跨主体（人类与算法）的复杂互动现象。为此，作者提出了STARC（结构化理论适应韧性网络安全）框架。该框架以吉登斯的结构化理论为基础，并进行了三项扩展：多层级对抗主体性（考虑攻击者、防御者在不同层级的策略行为）、威胁适应性结构化（结构在对抗动态中如何被不断调整）以及物质-能动性结构属性（将技术系统、算法决策视为具有结构影响力的“物”）。STARC将网络安全实践拆解为五个结构-能动性三元组（structure-agency triads），覆盖了从分析师日常操作到高管战略决策，再到行业监管的各个层面。论文通过重新分析来自澳大利亚、印度尼西亚和马来西亚三家银行共20次访谈的数据（涵盖SOC分析师、经理、CISO等角色）对该框架进行了实证说明，展示了不同外包程度和资源禀赋的组织在安全弹性上的结构性差异。最终，STARC不仅提供了一个诊断跨层级、跨节奏（从实时响应到长期规划）以及人机权威边界上事件响应失败原因的分析词汇，还推导出了七个可检验的研究命题（如“结构化一致性与组织韧性正相关”），为后续实证研究奠定了理论基础。该研究主要面向安全管理者、政策制定者以及学术研究者，帮助他们从宏观结构视角理解安全生态的成败根源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提供了超越单一层面的结构性解释，帮助安全管理者理解为何相似投入下组织韧性差异巨大，并为诊断复杂事件响应失败提供了新分析框架。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究提供了超越单一层面的结构性解释，帮助安全管理者理解为何相似投入下组织韧性差异巨大，并为诊断复杂事件响应失败提供了新分析框架。

items.title: Verifiable blind probabilistic error cancellation
items.summary: Quantum error mitigation (QEM) is an essential tool for mitigating hardware noise without incurring space overhead. Yet, its reliability depends on modeling, calibration, and implementation, leaving end-to-end security on untrusted quantum hardware unresolved. We address this problem by introducing verifiable blind probabilistic error cancellation (VBPEC), the first secure verification protocol against a fully malicious adversary that integrates QEM. VBPEC brings probabilistic error cancellation (PEC), a widely studied QEM technique, within the scope of composable security by formalizing delegated mitigation as a cryptographic resource in the abstract cryptography framework. The protocol performs PEC with perfect blindness and an exponentially small security error. VBPEC retains the absence of quantum-space overhead from recent statistically-secure verified quantum computation protocols and from PEC. The only overhead takes the form of additional repetitions due to the QEM procedure. To achieve this, we extend trap-based verification from deterministic pass/fail checks to statistical tests that benefit from QEM and develop a new proof technique that integrates the corresponding additional deviation sources. Rather than merely tolerating honest noise below a fixed threshold, VBPEC actively cancels it, enabling correctly mitigated estimates to be accepted with high probability without compromising security. Our framework thus establishes an essential route towards secure, reliable, and practical delegated quantum computation on near-future quantum hardware: VBPEC fundamentally improves the practicality of verification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 量子误差缓解（QEM）是当前减轻量子硬件噪声、避免空间开销的关键技术，但其可靠性高度依赖建模、校准与实现过程，导致在不可信量子硬件上执行委托量子计算时缺乏端到端安全性。针对这一问题，本文提出可验证盲化概率误差消除（VBPEC）协议，这是首个针对完全恶意敌手、集成QEM的安全验证协议。VBPEC将广泛研究的概率误差消除（PEC）技术纳入可组合安全框架，通过抽象密码学形式化地将委托缓解过程定义为密码学资源。协议在完美盲化条件下执行PEC，安全误差指数级小，且保留了近期统计安全验证量子计算协议及PEC本身无额外量子空间开销的优点，仅因QEM过程引入额外的重复次数。为实现这一目标，作者将基于陷阱的验证从确定性通过/失败检查扩展为受益于QEM的统计测试，并开发了新的证明技术来整合由此产生的额外偏差来源。VBPEC并非被动容忍低于固定阈值的诚实噪声，而是主动消除噪声，使得正确缓解的估计结果能够以高概率被接受，同时不牺牲安全性。该工作为在近期量子硬件上实现安全、可靠、实用的委托量子计算开辟了关键路径，显著提升了验证协议的实际可行性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作首次将量子误差缓解与可验证量子计算结合，解决了委托计算中处理恶意量子云服务商的完整性及隐私问题，为未来量子云的安全应用奠定理论基础。

items.why_it_matters: 该工作首次将量子误差缓解与可验证量子计算结合，解决了委托计算中处理恶意量子云服务商的完整性及隐私问题，为未来量子云的安全应用奠定理论基础。

items.title: SignDeepSC: A Semantic Signature-based Approach for Robust Semantic Communication
items.summary: Semantic communication systems such as deep semantic communication (DeepSC) offer high efficiency but are vulnerable to adversarial attacks on their underlying neural networks. We address a physical-layer man-in-the-middle (MitM) threat in which an adversary injects perturbations into the transmitted signal to distort its meaning. We propose SignDeepSC, an architectural defense that achieves adversarial robustness without requiring explicit adversarial example generation during training. The approach is built on a perceiver-inspired semantic signature, a compact vector summary of the source features transmitted over a separate low-rate auxiliary channel. This signature is used by a self-repairing decoder that leverages cross-attention to correct distortions and can additionally drive a scrambler that shuffles the feature layout. We evaluate SignDeepSC over Rayleigh fading and additive white Gaussian noise channels under both single-step fast gradient sign method (FGSM) and iterative projected gradient descent (PGD) attacks. Under PGD ($ε= 0.7$), at 12~dB signal-to-noise ratio with Rayleigh fading, SignDeepSC achieves a bilingual evaluation understudy (BLEU-4) score of 0.237 and bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) sentence similarity of 0.646, outperforming all baselines without degrading clean-channel performance, when the signature channel is well protected.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对深度语义通信（DeepSC）系统在物理层面临的一种中间人（MitM）威胁——攻击者向传输信号中注入扰动以扭曲其语义含义——提出了一种名为 SignDeepSC 的架构级防御方案。该方案的核心是一种基于感知器（Perceiver）的语义签名，即源特征的紧凑向量摘要，通过一条独立的低速率辅助信道传输。接收端利用一个自修复解码器，通过交叉注意力机制根据签名纠正信号失真；此外，签名还可驱动特征加扰器，打乱特征布局以增强防御。实验在瑞利衰落和加性高斯白噪声信道上，针对单步 FGSM 和迭代 PGD 攻击进行评估。在 PGD（ε=0.7）、12 dB 信噪比、瑞利衰落条件下，SignDeepSC 达到了 BLEU-4 0.237 和 BERT 句子相似度 0.646，在签名信道得到良好保护时，所有基线方法均被超越，且未降低干净信道性能。该工作为鲁棒语义通信提供了新的防御思路，适合通信安全、对抗性机器学习领域的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 语义通信系统在物理层易受中间人扰动攻击，SignDeepSC 提出一种无需对抗训练即可实现鲁棒性的轻量级架构，对保障下一代通信系统的语义安全具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要高可靠性语义传输的场景，如自动驾驶、远程手术等对通信内容完整性敏感的应用。
detection_signals_zh: 物理层信号异常：检测到独立辅助信道上的签名与主信道信号特征不匹配；
解码端语义相似度骤降：BERT/BLEU 分数低于预期阈值。
defense_advice_zh: 部署语义签名辅助信道，对签名信道进行加密/完整性保护；
在接收端启用自修复解码器与特征加扰机制；
根据信道状态动态调整签名传输速率与保护强度。

items.why_it_matters: 语义通信系统在物理层易受中间人扰动攻击，SignDeepSC 提出一种无需对抗训练即可实现鲁棒性的轻量级架构，对保障下一代通信系统的语义安全具有重要参考价值。

items.title: SkillGate: Cost Efficient Runtime Malicious Skill File Detection in Coding Agents
items.summary: Software engineering teams now deploy AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as first-class productivity tools, installing domain-specific skill files to tailor agent behavior to project APIs, framework conventions, and organizational workflows. These complex Markdown files are easily downloaded from public registries with a single npx skills add command and no real security screening, representing a novel supply-chain attack surface: a malicious skill file can silently reprogram agent behavior, exfiltrating credentials, injecting backdoors into generated code, or redirecting agent actions to attacker-controlled endpoints. The threat is not hypothetical: recent reports document hundreds of malicious skill packages in public registries, including organized campaigns that distributed credential-stealing infostealers via fake productivity skills. No systematic toolchain defense exists for this attack surface. We present SkillGate, a deployable security gateway that screens AI skill packages before coding agent installation. SkillGate uses a hybrid regex-prefilter + LLM-judge pipeline: safe-signal files bypass the LLM entirely (skip savings); flagged files have only their matched snippet windows sent to the judge, not the full content (snippet savings). We answer four research questions covering detection effectiveness, screening cost, runtime overhead, and false positive behavior on the SkillsBench benchmark against two existing tools. On SkillsBench (n=1,650, 9.1% malicious), SkillGate achieves F1=0.817, FPR=1.13% while reducing LLM input tokens by 77% vs. full-file screening, and outperforming existing tools by 5-6x on threshold-independent AUPRC (0.830 vs. 0.144/0.162).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对AI编码代理（如Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot）中技能文件（Skill File）带来的新型供应链攻击面，提出了一种成本高效的运行时恶意检测系统SkillGate。技能文件是Markdown格式的配置文件，用于定制代理行为以适应项目API、框架约定等，可通过`npx skills add`命令从公共注册表一键安装，且缺乏安全审查。已有报告显示公共注册表中存在数百个恶意技能包，包括通过虚假生产力技能传播凭证窃取程序的攻击活动。当前尚无系统化的工具链防御手段。SkillGate作为可部署的安全网关，在编码代理安装技能包之前进行筛查。其核心采用混合正则预过滤+LLM审判（LLM-Judge）流水线：安全信号文件直接绕过LLM（节省成本），被标记的文件仅将匹配的片段窗口发送给LLM审判者，而非完整内容（进一步节省令牌）。研究者在自主构建的SkillsBench基准（n=1650，9.1%为恶意）上评估了SkillGate的检测效果、筛查成本、运行时开销和误报行为，并与两款现有工具对比。结果显示，SkillGate在F1=0.817、假阳性率1.13%的同时，相比全文件筛查减少了77%的LLM输入令牌，且在不依赖阈值的AUPRC指标上以0.830远超现有工具的0.144/0.162（提升5-6倍）。本文适合安全工程师、AI代理开发者和供应链安全研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI编码代理正逐步成为开发团队的核心生产力工具，其技能文件供应链攻击面尚未被充分防御。SkillGate首次提供了系统化的运行时检测方案，填补了该领域的空白，对防范通过恶意技能文件进行的凭证窃取、后门注入等攻击具有重要实践意义。

items.title: Mapping CVEs to MITRE ATT&CK Techniques: A Curated Gold-Set Classifier and the Limits of LLM-Assisted Label Expansion
items.summary: We present a reproducible pipeline for mapping Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) to MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise techniques from free-text vulnerability descriptions. Rather than relying on the CWE->CAPEC->ATT&CK derivation chain, whose table-expansion artifacts we quantify, we train a multi-label classifier on a curated gold dataset of 1,207 CVEs from expert MITRE Center for Threat-Informed Defense mappings. The resulting model approximately doubles recall@5 compared with a zero-shot embedding-similarity baseline and improves every ranking metric. We then investigate whether LLM-assisted labeling can extend the gold dataset. Initial experiments suggest contradictory conclusions: a single run indicates degraded performance, while averaging over five random seeds suggests a small gain. However, an independent replication and an expansion-size study (100--984 additional CVEs) show that the apparent improvement is an evaluation artifact. LLM-generated labels, with approximately 0.39 agreement with expert annotations, provide no reliable improvement at any expansion size and reduce rare-technique coverage at around 1,000 added CVEs (macro-F1 decreases by 0.04). The root cause is evaluation noise. Selecting checkpoints on a small test split effectively maximizes over many noisy evaluations, producing recall@5 differences of up to 0.05 between otherwise identical runs. Using a corrected protocol based on validation-split checkpoint selection, the gold-only model achieves recall@5 of (0.673 \pm 0.019), and repeating the decisive experiment confirms the null result for LLM expansion. A final scaling study shows that additional expert-curated data consistently improves performance, whereas LLM-labeled data does not, indicating that the classifier is limited by label quality rather than dataset size. All datasets, models, code, and training logs are publicly released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一个可复现的流水线，用于从自由文本漏洞描述中将通用漏洞披露（CVE）映射到MITRE ATT&CK企业技术。研究者首先量化了传统的CWE->CAPEC->ATT&CK推导链中的表格扩展伪影，然后基于由MITRE威胁知情防御中心专家映射的1,207个CVE黄金数据集，训练了一个多标签分类器。该模型在recall@5上相比零样本嵌入相似度基线大约提升了一倍，并改进了所有排名指标。接着，研究者探究了LLM辅助标注是否能够扩展黄金数据集。初步实验得出矛盾结论：单次运行显示性能下降，而五次随机种子的平均结果则提示小幅提升。然而，独立复制研究和扩展规模研究（增加100至984个CVE）表明，这种看似改进实际上是评估伪影。LLM生成的标签与专家标注的一致性约为0.39，在任何扩展规模下都未提供可靠改进，并且在增加约1,000个CVE时减少了稀有技术的覆盖（macro-F1下降0.04）。根本原因是评估噪声。在小测试集上选择检查点实际上相当于在多次噪声评估中最大化，导致相同运行间recall@5差异高达0.05。使用基于验证集检查点选择的修正协议后，仅使用黄金数据的模型recall@5达到0.673±0.019，重复决定性实验确认了LLM扩展的零结果。最终的规模研究表明，增加专家策划的数据持续提升性能，而LLM标注的数据则不能，表明分类器受限于标签质量而非数据集大小。所有数据集、模型、代码和训练日志均已公开。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究量化了LLM辅助标注在CVE到ATT&CK映射任务中的局限性，强调了标签质量比数据集大小更重要，对安全运营中自动化威胁建模具有重要实践指导意义。

items.title: Optimistic Verifiable Claims: A Blockchain Protocol for Conditionally Confidential Bidding in Decentralized Manufacturing
items.summary: Decentralized manufacturing faces a pre-contractual impasse: a Provider cannot price a service accurately without inspecting the design file, yet the Consumer cannot share that file without exposing intellectual property. We introduce the Optimistic Verifiable Claim (OVC), a blockchain protocol that lets a Consumer publish a verifiable claim about a concealed design (such as the material it consumes) and a Provider price and bid on it without seeing the design. The claim is committed when the service is posted and stands unless the selected Provider challenges it; a challenge triggers a deterministic on-chain check that exposes any dishonesty, and the design is disclosed only to settle a dispute, never on the honest path. We implement four checks (authorized key access, delivery-channel integrity, syntactic conformance, and declared material consumption) in Solidity and measure them on a real 6.41 MB G-code file, the 3DBenchy, across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and opBNB. Every service incurs the cost of posting the encrypted design, with or without a dispute. For the 3DBenchy, the no-dispute outcome costs \$7,207 in up to 9 hours on Ethereum, \$288 in 3 min on Arbitrum, and \$2.87 in 2 min on opBNB, and a fully contested dispute costs \$49,660 in up to 57 hours on Ethereum, \$1,988 in 19 min on Arbitrum, and \$19.73 in 13 min on opBNB. Costs and times grow with size: for a 50 MB industrial design, an undisputed service reaches \$56,173 and up to 3 days on Ethereum against \$22.36 and 16 min on opBNB, and a fully contested dispute reaches \$488,440 over up to 18 days on Ethereum against \$195 and 1.6 hours on opBNB. Of the four, the material-consumption check is the costliest, its predicate being the most expensive to evaluate on-chain. OVC makes confidential, claim-based bidding economically feasible on Arbitrum and opBNB, but not on Ethereum at industrial scale.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 去中心化制造面临一个预签约困境：供应商无法在不检查设计文件的情况下准确报价，但消费者又无法在不暴露知识产权的情况下共享文件。本文提出乐观可验证声明（Optimistic Verifiable Claim, OVC）协议，允许消费者发布一个关于隐藏设计（如消耗的材料量）的可验证声明，供应商可以基于该声明进行定价和投标，而无需查看设计。该声明在发布时被提交，除非选中的供应商提出挑战，否则保持有效；挑战会触发确定性的链上检查，揭露任何不诚实行为，并且仅在解决争议时披露设计，在诚实的路径上从不披露。作者用Solidity实现了四种检查（授权密钥访问、交付通道完整性、语法符合性、声明的材料消耗），并在以太坊、Arbitrum和opBNB上对真实的6.41 MB G-code文件（3DBenchy）进行了测试。每个服务都需要支付发布加密设计的成本，无论是否有争议。对于3DBenchy，无争议结果在以太坊上花费7207美元（最长9小时），在Arbitrum上花费288美元（3分钟），在opBNB上花费2.87美元（2分钟）；完全争议在以太坊上花费49660美元（最长57小时），在Arbitrum上花费1988美元（19分钟），在opBNB上花费19.73美元（13分钟）。成本和时间随文件大小增长：对于50 MB的工业设计，无争议服务在以太坊上达到56173美元（最长3天），而opBNB仅为22.36美元（16分钟）；完全争议在以太坊上达到488440美元（最长18天），而opBNB仅为195美元（1.6小时）。四种检查中，材料消耗检查成本最高，其谓词在链上评估最昂贵。OVC使基于声明的保密投标在Arbitrum和opBNB上经济可行，但在工业规模下以太坊不可行。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该协议解决了去中心化制造中知识产权保护与交易效率的矛盾，为需要条件保密和防欺诈的智能合约应用提供了新范式，对安全工程师理解区块链隐私和争议解决机制有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要保护设计文件或敏感数据的投标、审计、供应链场景，促进区块链在实际制造中的落地。

items.title: Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection via Cumulative Entropy
items.summary: Recent training-time defenses against neural backdoors isolate a benign subset from poisoned training data, to learn a backdoor-free model from it. In this paper, we formulate this defense strategy as a coreset selection problem, giving rise to so-called "Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection." Since poisonous samples have (a) lower prediction uncertainty and are (b) less frequent than benign samples, coreset selection naturally focuses more on samples associated with benign functionality than the backdoor functionality. We use the Cumulative Entropy as selection criterion to further facilitate this effect. The metric tracks the learning dynamics of training samples and allowing us to select benign samples with high informativeness for the coreset. Additionally, we unlearn the chosen samples in each epoch to facilitate the separability between benign and poisonous samples. Together, this yields an exceptionally effective training-time defense that constructs a benign coreset to train a backdoor-free model. Unlike prior defenses that compromise natural accuracy and fail against certain attacks, our method mitigates backdooring attacks consistently with a negligible impact on natural performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对神经网络后门攻击提出了一种训练阶段的防御方法。作者将防御策略形式化为核心集选择问题，即从被污染的训练数据中隔离出一个良性子集，并仅用该子集训练模型，从而消除后门。与现有方法不同，本文的核心创新在于使用累积熵作为选择准则。累积熵能够追踪训练样本的学习动态，从而有效区分良性样本和有毒样本：有毒样本通常预测不确定性较低且数量较少，因此核心集选择会自然倾向于良性样本。此外，每轮训练后对已选样本进行“遗忘”（即降低其损失权重）可进一步增强样本的可分离性。实验表明，该方法在保持自然准确率几乎不变的情况下，能够持续缓解多种后门攻击，克服了以往防御方法牺牲自然性能或仅针对特定攻击的局限。本文适合机器学习安全研究人员和模型防御工程师阅读，可作为训练阶段后门防御的参考方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种新颖的训练时后门防御方法，通过累积熵选择良性核心集，在保持自然性能的同时有效抵御多种攻击，对提升模型安全性有实际参考价值。

items.why_it_matters: 提出了一种新颖的训练时后门防御方法，通过累积熵选择良性核心集，在保持自然性能的同时有效抵御多种攻击，对提升模型安全性有实际参考价值。

items.title: Architectural Backdoors in Vision-Language Model Supply Chains via Representation Steering
items.summary: Vision--Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed through a model supply chain in which pretrained checkpoints, architecture definitions, text encoders, and exported computation graphs are distributed by third parties and reused across downstream services. This reuse model creates a security-critical trust boundary: VLM deployments inherit not only learned parameters but also executable behavior encoded in shared model artifacts. In this paper, we show that a malicious provider can exploit this trust boundary by embedding architectural backdoors into VLM supply chains through representation steering. Our attack introduces dormant steering logic into the model architecture through a trigger-gated additive modification of an intermediate representation, without poisoning training data, controlling downstream fine-tuning, or modifying prompts at deployment time. When the trigger is absent, the modification reduces to zero and the model follows its normal computation, preserving clean utility. When the trigger is present, a steering direction shifts the internal representation toward an attacker-defined objective. We evaluate the attack across multiple VLM families and downstream tasks, including visual question answering, text-to-image generation, retrieval, and semantic response biasing. The results show that the proposed architectural steering backdoor compromises integrity, safety enforcement, and ranking fairness while preserving normal behavior on clean inputs. We further show that shared VLM artifacts can carry dormant steering logic against downstream services, and we propose an auditing defense that inspects the executable logic distributed with model artifacts rather than only their learned weights.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文揭示了视觉-语言模型（VLM）供应链中的新型安全威胁。VLM通常通过模型供应链进行部署，其中预训练检查点、架构定义、文本编码器和导出计算图等组件由第三方分发，并在下游服务中复用。这种复用模式创建了一个关键的安全信任边界：VLM部署不仅继承学习参数，还继承了共享模型工件中编码的可执行行为。论文证明，恶意提供者可以通过表示引导在VLM供应链中嵌入架构后门。该攻击在模型架构中引入休眠引导逻辑，通过触发门控的中间表示加法修改实现，无需污染训练数据、控制下游微调或修改部署时的提示。当触发器不存在时，修改归零，模型正常计算，保持清洁效用；当触发器存在时，引导方向将内部表示移向攻击者定义的目标。论文在多个VLM系列和下游任务上评估了攻击，包括视觉问答、文本到图像生成、检索和语义响应偏置。结果表明，该架构引导后门在清洁输入上保持正常行为的同时，损害了完整性、安全强制和排序公平性。论文进一步证明，共享的VLM工件可以携带休眠引导逻辑攻击下游服务，并提出了一种审计防御方法，检查与模型工件一起分发的可执行逻辑，而不仅限于学习参数。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: VLM供应链安全至关重要，该研究揭示了一种隐蔽的后门植入方式，无需训练数据或控制微调，威胁模型提供方信任，对依赖第三方模型组件的安全实践有重大警示。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用第三方VLM组件的下游应用，如视觉问答、图像生成、检索系统等，可导致完整性破坏、安全机制失效、排序不公平。
detection_signals_zh: 检查模型工件的可执行逻辑（如计算图）中是否存在非预期的加法或引导操作
监控模型在特定触发输入下输出偏差（如语义偏置）
defense_advice_zh: 采用作者提出的审计防御，验证模型工件中分发的可执行逻辑而非仅检查权重
在供应链中建立对模型组件的完整性验证机制
